seo.title: Quick Scan, Decision Sparring, Improvement Sprint | McCate
seo.description: Three short ways to get complex projects moving: quick scan, decision sparring and improvement sprint, for spatial development and innovation.

title: Services
sub: Three short ways to get moving, for organisations in spatial development and innovation. Each one starts with the people who have to decide.

items.title: Quick scan
items.text: In one to two weeks we map where your project or process stalls and what would unblock it fastest. You get a clear picture on one page and a short list of what to do first.
bullets: One-page overview of bottlenecks and options
Recommended first steps, ranked by impact

items.title: Decision sparring
items.text: A sounding board for the people who have to decide. We bring an outside view, summarise the big picture and help you weigh the options, with attention to the process and to the people it affects.
bullets: A follow-up check after the decision

items.title: Improvement sprint
items.text: When an improvement needs hands as well as advice, we lead a short sprint with a clear goal and then hand over. This is interim management in its short, focused form.
bullets: Fixed goal and duration, usually four to twelve weeks
Keep operations running, find the bottlenecks, automate what repeats
Active in your team, then a clean handover

cta: Not sure which fits? Describe your situation and we will tell you what we would do first.
